name: The Legend of Stalvan
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The name Stalvan rings a bell.  I remember now.

Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night.  Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with fear.  Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.

In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs.  He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in Stormwind.  Help yourself to it.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in Stormwind.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
narrative.requestItemsText: What have ya got there? Let me take a look at that. . .
